text: Inside own settlement: big floating world-label '0 here, 3/8 residents' bleeds behind the top HUD/chronicle; bottom-right Season panel overlaps Player Info (only 'Role: LEADER' row visible, Energy/Nation hidden). Tick ~5118.

Inside own settlement with member Judy Taylor 2.4m away, pressing E printed 'Exited settlement.' (tick 5994) instead of talking; the on-screen Talk/Gift/Order buttons do work as a path, but E (the documented talk key) always prefers the settlement. Also pawn in my own nation is labelled '(Stranger)'. Objective bar text clipped: 'mbers 5/10'.

Inside settlement the action-bar rows shift up/down as pawns wander in and out of 5m: a click aimed at 'Talk to Judy Taylor' (155,414) one frame later landed on 'Send Caravan (Town era)' as the Talk row vanished. At a few fps this makes the talk/gift buttons a misclick trap; a stable slot would help.

Talk works via button: Judy Taylor, who the chronicle says 'joined Easternland' and who is a merchant in my own settlement, is labelled '(Stranger) - Loyal' and says 'Yes, leader? I hardly know you. Why should I follow you? I stand by my own.' Mixed message: is she in my nation or not? Tick 7558. Also huge floating caravan label text overprints the scene.

#358: Nations tab (O) shows only 'Easternland, 5 members, 1 camp. You lead it.'; Laws tab shows laws/defence/taxes; Settlement Info shows Residents 5/8. No screen lists who the members are, their loyalty, or who my heir is. High tax text says 'loyalty falls fast' but loyalty is never shown anywhere.

H from ~170m out in Smallford land (x310,z-493) put me at the well (4m from settlement center) with member Oscar Johnson 3.6m away: Talk/Gift/Order buttons immediately available. Works. Only feedback is 'You are back on your own land.' -- no 'Teleported home' message. Tick ~10500.

R (invite) on non-member Irene Thompson works with clear feedback: 'I'm loyal to Northshire.' (needs Loyal). But 'Loyal' is used both as a relationship tier needed for invite and as a personality trait in the Talk button ('Talk to Judy Taylor (Stranger) - Loyal'), so a member reads as 'Stranger, Loyal'. Confusing. Tick 14334.

Sell Resources in own settlement with 24 apples, 11 wood, 5 stone: 'No one is buying resources at this market or you do not have enough resources to sell.' -- the message does not say which, while the Market panel lists buy/sell prices for apples/wood/stone. Tick ~15100.

Ruler death could not be reached in a 30-min session: the only way the leader dies is starving (energy ~1 bar per in-game day, 10 game-min ~ 20 real min at 25 tps), the player auto-eats carried apples (24 here), and Sell Resources refuses to sell them, so there is no way to shed food. Heir is never shown before death, so a player cannot plan succession. Energy at tick ~15200: 91.
